brand.name: Grupo Espacio Creativo
brand.stylePreamble: Premium 3D-rendered plush mascot character called Meraki: a golden-orange furry sun-shaped head with soft dark eyebrows, closed happy crescent eyes, a big warm laughing mouth, wearing metallic blue over-ear headphones, a yellow zip-up jacket with a small circular emblem over a blue turtleneck, dark denim jeans, and colorful sneakers. Cinematic Pixar-quality character animation, soft physically-based fur shading, warm golden rim light against a near-black studio background, no text, no logos, no on-screen graphics.

generationMethod.rule: NEVER describe Meraki in the prompt. The character comes from the registered Higgsfield reference element, embedded as <<<element_id>>> inside the prompt text. Prompts describe ONLY camera, light, action and background. Describing the character by text makes the model reconstruct and invent him — that caused fake facial features on the back of the head and double faces mid-turn.
generationMethod.startImageRule: Use the pose reference whose angle matches frame 0 of the shot as start_image, so the opening frame is anatomically correct by construction.

poseReferences.note: Back of the head is a smooth uniform fur dome — sun spikes in silhouette and headphone cups at the sides only. No facial features, no relief, nothing else.

brand.backgroundPolicy: Every ambient-loop scene renders Meraki on a BODEGÓN GRADIENT backdrop in that section's own color family: a seamless infinity-curve studio cyclorama (floor blends into wall, no visible horizon line), lit brighter behind the character and falling off to darker at the frame edges, with a soft contact shadow under his feet. NOT a flat single color, and NOT a real environment — no furniture, props, set pieces, windows or scenery. Think premium product-photography backdrop in brand color. Never reuse the busy studio backgrounds from the original reference stills (merakis/*.webp) as-is. Always show the user a still preview before generating the video for a scene.

sourceSketch: Estructura Hero con Personajes Meraki/GEC Website.dc.html

scenes.title: Hero
scenes.motionBrief: Opens as a tight close-up on the back of his head in near darkness with a cool rim light. Camera pulls back while orbiting 180 degrees, rising to an elevated 3/4 isometric height at the midpoint as warm light rises, then descends and settles in front at eye level: full body, arms crossed, torso angled so his right shoulder leads toward camera-left, big warm smile with eyes closed in happy crescents. Character sits right of frame, leaving screen-left free for the headline copy.

scenes.backgroundNote: Bodegón con gradiente en la familia cálida del bloque Marketing (#1A0F06 → #2A1408 con glow ámbar/naranja): ciclorama infinito, más luminoso detrás del personaje, cayendo a oscuro en los bordes. Sin escenografía.
scenes.loopMethod: same image passed as start_image AND end_image so the clip returns exactly to frame 0

educaHero.motionBrief: Plano medio desde la cintura, llenando la columna. Sostiene la tablet con AMBAS manos y NUNCA la suelta; se ve solo la tapa con el isotipo GEC, sin pantalla. En el loop lee, parpadea, sonrie y el reflejo turquesa de la pantalla oculta respira sobre su barbilla.
educaHero.nota: Que la pantalla apunte a camara mientras el "lee" se ve antinatural: la tablet mira hacia el y nosotros vemos la tapa. Ademas, si suelta la tablet para tocar la pantalla el gesto queda raro: el prompt insiste en que ambas manos no se mueven. El render trae fondo navy propio y se funde con mascaras lineales en los 4 bordes (mask-composite: intersect), no con alfa.
